steps.text: A long, long time ago, there was a little girl who lived happily in a beautiful town.
One day, a storm brought with it countless black rocks and destroyed her home.
In search of a way to restore her homeland's beauty, she found the courage to set out on a journey.
The legends told of a most-amazing caster who lived in a faraway, marvelous land, and his Originium Arts could make all that is impossible possible.
During her journeys, she met a fowlbeast that couldn't fly and a tin man who was nothing but an empty shell.
The fowlbeast wanted to learn to fly, and the tin man wanted to find its body. They all had different dreams.
To find this marvelous land, they walked for a long, long time. So long, that the fowlbeast shed all its feathers and the tin man began to rust.
'I will give you my wings. With them, you can fan away the dust,' the fowlbeast said.
'I will give you my tin plates. With it, you can make it through the storm,' the tin man said.
The girl wore the fowlbeast's wings and the tin man's plates and flew past the desert and the storm.
She found the caster, only to discover an incoherent madman.
The girl cried in sadness, but her friends were there with her and started to talk to her.
'Thank you. I flew across an insurmountable desert,' the wings said.
'Thank you. I felt the warmth of a body once again,' the tin plates said.
'This has been such a wonderful journey,' they said together.
'In that case, my dream has come true too.' The girl hugged her friends. 'With you here by my side, I now have a new home.'
With the dreams of her friends, the girl set out on a journey again. This time, she did not set out to find a legendary caster.
She had an all-new goal. She would walk far, far away to where no one had ever gone before.
Dorothy, did you like the story Mommy told you?
She hesitated for a while, but it also seemed like the blink of an eye.
She saw green trees and red roses, a bright and beautiful day, as well as a quiet, endless dark night.
She saw a rainbow that stretched across the sky and reflected as smiles on the spectators' faces.
They walked close together, discussing food, weather, and the good harvest.
They saw her too and waved at her.
'Hello, Dorothy.'
'This is a nice place, isn't it, Dorothy?'
'There's an endless supply of clean water and food here... and all the wild beasts have gone away.'
'It's so great to relax here.'
'All the data from those experiments are driving me crazy, though. I'm always afraid that the director might show up out of nowhere.'
'We shouldn't stay here too long, though. A storm might be coming.'
'Don't worry. We know how to deal with those. Otherwise, why would we even have come here?'
'What is there to worry about, then?'
'Haha... That we can't be on our way tomorrow, of course.'
'And we don't know whether we'll ever find another place like this again.'
'It doesn't matter if we run away... tomorrow's still coming.'
'If all I do is hide here, when will I become the greatest scientist there ever was?'
'And that's why we'll be on our way as soon as it's light out.'
'Strange. What a long night this is...'

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Nngh—!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: It's moving more intensely! It's like... it's putting up a fight!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Perhaps that's because Dorothy is putting up a fight.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Do you believe her? This was Ms. Dorothy's experiment. Would she really willingly abandon a dream she's chased for years?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What Dorothy seeks isn't success.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If she can really hear the voices of her loved ones... she will make the choice that's most beneficial to them.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I wonder what she sees at this very moment?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Lacking sufficient reliable data.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I was able to feel them, but I did not receive a 'Transmitter' injection.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: One hypothesis is that the Device #9's sensitivity to signals has allowed me to receive fragments of some of the messages.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But those fragments contained certain specific words.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: They were emotions.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Language is a set of rules for command input and output. It cannot describe every tiny brainwave fluctuation in detail.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: If I must make a conjecture, I postulate that... Director Franks is dreaming.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She's dreaming...?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Whose dream? Is it Dorothy's own dream, or... a collective dream of all the Pioneers connected to the 'Hub?'

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I do not know.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Just like... when I was dreaming, I could not ascertain whose dream it was...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Joyce, your manner of speech...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Olivia...? I... I don't know what's going on...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Is your... device being jammed again?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I don't know either.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Olivia, I feel both sad and happy.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Are we all walking a path to an unknown destination, and a starting point we can no longer see?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I think so... especially for researchers like us.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: There is one thing... I've wanted to tell you for a long time.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Device #9 may have given me a lot of pain, and my journey may come to an end at any moment, but...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: It is thanks to your companionship—

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I never once felt alone or lost hope.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Mary, I gotta ask... am I gonna die here?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: If you're free enough to think about that, why don't you try to work a little harder?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Heh... Hah... We don't have too many bolts left, do we?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Before these... well-armed fellas shackle up my neck... while I can still breathe and think freely...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I got something to say.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Then say it. Look at how hard you're panting. Careful not to bite your tongue when you talk.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Haha, I love it when you say things like that.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Ever since I became their boss, they take every word I say as pure gold. It's exhausting.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Mary, I oughta be satisfied enough that... I get to die next to you.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: This isn't how you saw yourself biting it, huh?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I used to think that, it'd be great if I got to go out on a soft bed with my wife and kids holding my hand... and a bunch of letters from the people I'd helped sitting there on my nightstand...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Right, a window... The room's gotta have a window. I wanna see the sunlight one last time.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: When I think that, whether there's a room... or a bed...
It feels like it's not so important whether I have a wife or kids anymore.
Looks like...
I stopped caring about dying somewhere along the way, a long time ago.
Mommy, isn't a long journey hard? Why didn't everybody choose to stay somewhere safe?
Dorothy, everyone is hanging on because they want to see with their own eyes what the path far ahead holds.
Will I go on the journey with you one day?
Dorothy, you will make your own journey.
Mommy, why are you crying? Is it because you don't want me to leave? I don't have to go to the summer camp if you don't want me to go.
No, Dorothy... Your future doesn't belong to me.
Dorothy, one day, Mommy will stand here and send you off on your journey.
Dorothy, the sights you will see in the future will be like nothing I've ever seen.

steps.name: Young Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Dorothy, why are you crying?

steps.name: Young Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Don't you like this place?
The child stands on her tiptoes and reaches her hand out to try and wipe the tears on Dorothy's face.
Dorothy lifts her hand as well.
And just as she is about to take the girl's hand...
She puts her hand down.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No, my dear friend.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: This is... the land of dreams that I've been searching for all my life.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: How I hope I can find peace and happiness for all of you...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But your futures don't belong to me.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I shouldn't trap you here.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: And I... shouldn't trap myself here.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I will send you off on your journeys...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The sights you will see in the future will be like nothing I've ever seen.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Dr. Silence, am I seeing things? Are all the silver liquids... retreating?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The laboratory...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Why is it suddenly turning around and heading toward the labs?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: If it keeps going, it'll reach...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Right, that's its target... The place it was born.
With a loud bang, the remaining half of the building suddenly crumbles.
Unlike its previous growth stage, it does not patiently wait to dissolve the crumbled building's structure.
It simply retrieves all the energy and, without hesitation, it tears into its own heart.
The large, geometric construct rapidly crumbles away.
The dust scatters in all directions, and a stream of silver liquid slowly flows on the ground. The sky, too, has returned to its original color.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Impossible.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The data... Show me the data.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The test subject disconnected from the 'Hub,' and its structure completely collapsed...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The 'Hub' is... destroyed?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Mary...?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm not dreaming, am I? That monster... is actually gone?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We're saved.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We're saved—Mary, did you see that?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Don't... let your guard down. Huff... We still have the bad guys from Rhine Lab to deal with...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Wait, are the Rhine Labbers retreating?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Hold on... Who's that...? And are they wearing...?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Director Franks destroyed her own creation.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She did it...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: You believed in her the whole time, didn't you?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Greyy, she said... you have the same kind of courage as the Pioneers.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I couldn't tell her in time that... she was just as brave—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: So brave that she was willing to wake up from the dream she weaved of her own love.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Dorothy, how do you feel? Does it hurt anywhere?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I can't say I feel very good, but...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I feel relaxed.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: So... did you find your answer?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Answer?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No... What I found was a new journey.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: And it belongs only to them.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I... I have another path to walk.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: How does it feel to have your dreams crushed?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Only Dorothy knows the exact location of the 'Hub.'

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Could it really be that Dorothy destroyed the system she created herself...? Can she control this creation?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You can't imagine that, can you?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's because you've never considered the possibility that Dorothy would inject herself too—That she would plug herself into that thing.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's not like you saw her do it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I didn't, but I know her.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Her heart lies with the Pioneers. For them, she would do whatever it took as many times as it took, without hesitation, and she'd choose to stop when and if it became necessary.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I have to find her.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Her research is more impressive than I imagined. Our experiment is not over yet—

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: What's going on? Where are the Defense personnel—

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Director Clooney, the observation station's surrounded!

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: On whose authority...? No, it doesn't matter who they are. How did they find out about the site?!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: My Arts... Finally, it's enough for those control panels you use to disrupt communications. It did take me some time, so I've got to thank you for teaching me patience.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You did it right in front of me...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If you would just... pay more attention to what's going on around you and listen more carefully when you talk, you could've figured me out.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: They're here, Director Clooney... Ugh!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Rhine Lab Energy Section Director, Ferdinand Clooney.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: We have proof beyond a reasonable doubt that you have violated clinical laboratory regulations and have been conducting illegal experiments at this site.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Surrender immediately and order your subordinates to drop their weapons.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: This is all just a misunderstanding. Please let me make a call.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Not exactly in accordance with procedure, but... knock yourself out.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The number's not in service...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Who do you work for? I need to talk to the colonel.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Look, I know a lot of colonels who run a lot of regiments. You want to be a little more specific?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Well...
There are countless weapons pointed at him.
The name is frozen on the tip of his tongue.
Suddenly, Ferdinand is relieved that he did not reveal the name to the crowd.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Pick up your comm.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Hahaha...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I get it now, Kristen.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You won. Congratulations.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: This was never about winning or losing, Ferdinand.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Your bet almost destroyed Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Rhine...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I told you I would build the most fantastic laboratory in all of Terra here, and I did it.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I will ensure that the Rhine name lives on gloriously in the epoch to come.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: And what about you? Do you really care about Rhine, Kristen?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You don't. You only want to burn all our efforts as fuel for yourself.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's for Rhine's sake that you must be stopped...

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Rhine Lab doesn't belong to you. It doesn't belong to anyone.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Ferdinand Clooney, you're too easily distracted. Rhine doesn't need an academic like you.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You came here just to fire me, Control?

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: I'm reminding you to make the smart choice.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You mean... accept your proposal to hire a top lawyer and use your relationship with the government to have me locked away in a state prison for two centuries?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: How smart that would be.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Ferdinand—!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: He... He killed himself?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: *cough*... The floor structure here's broken through...

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: I think he might have escaped, ma'am.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: It's a pain in the neck to catch these smartasses who make preparations in advance... but not like we had much of a choice.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: After him. He won't get far without help.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: It all turned out just as you wanted, Saria.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: The situation has changed... thanks to the message you and Rhodes Island brought here.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Ferdinand failed, and you 'saved' Rhine Lab once again.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I should go.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Saria—

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: I don't remember everything that happened all those years ago.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: I noticed that you've tweaked your Arts casting methods. The reconstitution effect your calcification has on matter particles is more complicated and intricate now.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: You abandoned the formula that the two of us developed together in the early days.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Defense techniques that have been cracked have no value.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: And I was the only one ever to crack calcification.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Goodbye, Kristen.
He hated these preparations.
After all, only losers have to resort to backup plans.
Ferdinand's laboratory has never needed so many plans. After all, he has always had a masterful control of the tides.
Many say that he is a capable businessman, but they don't understand.
He simply stays on the right path and marches on endlessly.
As long as you walk faster than anyone, money and attention will come pouring in.
And with these resources, he can walk faster and farther.
But...
Today, he has no choice but to walk this dark, narrow path. An escape route that he never seriously considered he would have to take.
There is someone waiting for him at the end of this path.
Why would anyone be waiting for him?
His coworkers, his family, Elena... None of them knew about his plan.
Aside from him, there should be no one who knows this place.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You're here at last, Ferdinand.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I've been waiting entire minutes.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Ho'olheyak.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I never expected... *cough*... that the last person to help me would be a mercenary.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You aren't here to help me.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Then—Why not pull the trigger already?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Relax, Ferdinand. I'm not here to kill you either.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I'm not sure I believe that.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The colonel... The army wants me silenced. I'm sure of it.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: And Kristen wants me locked up... I'd turn crazy like Loken Williams if I ended up in prison. Either that, or I would have to roll over and rot away as a corpse.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Mad scientists are hardly a strange sight here in Columbia, but it's not like the military or the government could shoulder the infamy that comes with sacrificing civilians in evil experiments.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I have no idea... how Kristen caught wind of what's going on in the site so easily or how she managed to convince the bureaucrats in the government in such a short amount of time...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's you.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You are no normal mercenary. You are a spy... Did the government send you? Who do you work for?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Shh, let's not waste our breath on all that.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: In Columbia, men like you can't hide anything, not even escape routes that look so discreet on the surface.
He watches as the woman in front of him walks closer. A chill runs down his spine.
Not even the conversation he had with Kristen a few minutes ago made him despair.
Yet, right now, with the Liberi reaching her hand out toward him, an extreme pain rushes up from his stomach and claws at his throat—
He almost vomits on the spot.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Look how messy your hair is, Ferdinand.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It would ruin your image if you went out like this.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Right, you might want to know that I've already torn your getaway car to pieces.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: But you just made a very smart choice.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You could've dragged Kristen and Rhine Lab down with you, but you didn't.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You do actually care as much about Rhine Lab as you said... You made sure that there is still hope for everyone in the future, even if that future doesn't necessarily include you.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: So... Right, I'll say it how you like to say it.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I forgive you.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Walk forward about another ten yards. There's a suit of power armor in the firefighting cabinet.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: —The newest kind.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You can wear it. You can control it remotely. You can even ignore it. It's your call.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Even though you can never come back to Trimounts... and it'd be in your best interest to stay away from other nomadic cities, there are still vaster lands waiting for you.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Now hop to it—

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: —'Pioneer.'
